pages.title: Spawning
pages.text: They drift through forests and plains, and may be the first Gensokyo creature a player meets.$(br2)Left alone, a fairy is harmless, just a little clingy. She follows whoever is holding something she wants, and vanishes the moment she is satisfied.$(br2)A cake is a proper meal, and she throws you Fairy Dust for it — worth the trip. Cookies are food she likes too; for one she returns a flower picked at random.

pages.title: Fairy Dust
pages.text: Right-click a flower with it and the dust draws a thread toward the nearest Gensokyo structure — useful when you have no other way to find one.

pages.title: Fairy Cake
pages.text: A single slice is enough to satisfy a fairy.$(br2)Eating one yourself lets you float for a while, just like a fairy.
